faq.a: Ousmane is associated with the Arabic form عُثْمَان, whose core sense is ousmane; uthman (west african form).

faq.q: What is the origin of Ousmane?
faq.a: Ousmane is associated with Arabic. Ousmane is the West African form of Arabic عُثْمَان (ʿUthmān), a male given name borne by the third caliph.
Yes — the underlying form عُثْمَان is Arabic.
Ousmane can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
Ousmane should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. ʿUthmān is not a Quranic personal name.

faq.q: What does Ousmane mean in Urdu?
faq.a: In Urdu, Ousmane is rendered عثمان and carries the sense عثمان، نبی کا صحابی.

faq.q: What does Ousmane mean in Persian?
faq.a: In Persian, Ousmane is rendered عثمان and carries the sense عثمان، صحابه پیامبر.
A romanized syllable approximation is ous-ma-ne. No IPA transcription is asserted because a verified phonetic transcription was not available.

faq.q: What are the variants of Ousmane?
faq.a: Romanization variants include Ousmane, ousmane. Script forms are عثمان, عُثْمَان, उस्माने.

faq.q: Is Ousmane a boy's or girl's name?
faq.a: Documented usage records this form as male. Gender is not inferred from the meaning of the word, and actual use may vary between communities.
